fields.value: Clean up noisy top-of-page report notes for opponent-only anchors and cross-experiment env overlaps.

Clean up noisy top-of-page report notes for opponent-only anchors and cross-experiment env overlaps.

Problem (reproduced in manabot tla_frontier_snapshots combining baseline tau-x2 from tla_trophies_floor):
1. "Drawn as anchors, seated without an `at` and saved by no training run of the experiment: tau-x2@40901-u100, ..." fires for fixed H2H opponent checkpoints seated via CheckpointRef(address="r2://bucket/jobs/<exp>/<run>/...") even when they have zero fixed anchor cells (never drawn as anchor lines) and do not match compact "<exp>/<run>/..." keys in training_checkpoints. Do not emit "Drawn as anchors..." for pure opponents with no anchor cells.
2. "1 values were also played in tla-trophies {...}; the page shows each from the environment whose latest match is newest." fires for non-subject anchor/opponent cells (like heuristic) when a Curve merges tournaments across experiments whose environment configs differ only in non-gameplay telemetry flags (e.g. "cards": true). Ignore non-subject/non-plotted cells or demote minor env-overlap notes so the top of the report stays clean.

Related existing tasks: 1941b1 (collapse/fix "which nothing holds" seating warnings), 81e29f (summarize multi-seating/multi-tournament curve subtitles), 3e524c (draw a job's later points when one seed ended earlier).
